item.title: New York school pauses plan to deploy humanlike AI robot teacher after backlash

item.title: 'Machines are collaborators' at this new museum of AI art

item.title: As extreme heat grips the South and West, here's how to stay safe
item.description: Experts say immersion in cold water before an ambulance arrives can greatly increase the chances of heat stroke survival and reduce the risk of long-term complications.

item.description: Policymakers at the Federal Reserve are meeting to discuss interest rates Wednesday. They're expected to hold rates steady, but there's a chance they could raise rates to combat stubborn inflation.
